subject: Money
title: Winners and Losers
description: A fast breakdown of Winners and Losers for builders.

hook.text: Borrow $300,000 for a house. After 20 years of 3% inflation, that debt feels like $166,000 in today's dollars.

buildup.text: Inflation punishes savers and creditors. Cash loses value. Bonds pay back in cheaper dollars.

discovery.text: It rewards borrowers and asset owners. Debt shrinks in real terms. Houses and stocks rise with prices.

twist.text: Governments are the biggest borrowers. Inflation quietly reduces national debt without raising taxes.

climax.text: Inflation is a hidden transfer from lenders to borrowers, from the cautious to the leveraged.
